headline: Weakening Luxury Demand in China Deepens Headwinds for Hermès and Cartier
summary: Both affluent and aspirational consumers in China cut back on high-end discretionary spending, deepening sales contractions for premier European luxury brands including Hermès and Cartier parent Richemont.
why: Greater China accounts for a large share of global luxury group profits. Persistent consumer softness in the region pressures top-line revenues and operating margins across European luxury conglomerates.

impacts.name: Luxury Goods
impacts.why: Broader pullback in Chinese luxury consumption dampens forward earnings for major European fashion houses.
